title: The Split Nashville  8 minutes to Broadway
description:
Mid century modern home is equipped and styled to host a girls night in, a boy's night out, a working travel,  or family trip to Nashville.   The home features a private entrance and parking, an open concept kitchen, stainless steel appliances, two large living and entertaining areas, spacious bedrooms, and modern bathrooms.  Smart tv's throughout the home to keep you entertained for hours. Convenient  check-in with smart lock.  This newly remodeled home is 8 minutes from downtown.

The space
The kitchen has all new appliances and kitchenware, a Keurig coffee maker with coffee pods, a stove/microwave, and toaster! The bathroom is stocked with brand new towels and wash cloths, a hair dryer, along with toiletries. Washer and dryer available for your convenience!  Free WiFi. Charge stations to keep your devices powered up at all times.
